one-turn.text: Speak once and see the reply become voice, expression, and motion.

close.text: Meet Spatial Companion at ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.

first-run.text: Choose how your Companion connects before the first conversation begins.

quiet.text: The interface keeps the character central and the controls within reach.

your-model.text: Choose an on-device model, your Ollama endpoint, or another configured provider.

in-the-tab.text: When you choose an on-device model, the conversation can stay on the headset.

a-room.text: Enter the spatial stage and place the Companion in the room with you.
